Check SITAR random effects for non-identifiability

Source: R/curve-sitar.R
wgh_check_identifiable.Rd

Flags a model when any pair of random effects is correlated beyond a threshold. In the SITAR pubertal spurt study (Ho et al. 2026, medRxiv 2026.07.26.26358986) an extended SITAR model fitted well but its c and d effects correlated at 0.998, and it reversed which girls were early maturers. The check works on both sitar and plain nlme objects (the original helper silently returned "cannot evaluate" for nlme).

Usage

wgh_check_identifiable(fit, max_abs_corr = 0.95)

Arguments

fit

A wgh_sitar, sitar or nlme model.

max_abs_corr

Threshold.

Value

A list with ok, max_abs_corr, the pair and a reason.

Examples

# \donttest{
boys <- growdat2_mini[growdat2_mini$sex == "Male", ]
fit <- wgh_fit_sitar(boys, df = 4, age_range = c(6, 18))
wgh_check_identifiable(fit)
#> $ok
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $max_abs_corr
#> [1] 0.5851957
#> 
#> $pair
#> [1] "b-c"
#> 
#> $reason
#> [1] "OK: random effects b-c correlated at r = -0.585"
#> 
# }
